description.value:
Everyone in Night City knows the characteristic rattle of this submachine gun. Designed in the 2040s, Militech intended the Saratoga to be a versatile piece in their corporate security arsenal. However, its advantages – small frame, light weight, relatively cheap price, ease of use and modifiability – also rendered this SMG a major hit outside the glass towers of Corpo Plaza. This is the ideal weapon for vehicular and urban combat.

Cost: 350eb (Expensive)

Class: SMG • Skill: Handgun • Range: SMG

Damage: 2d6 • Capacity: 40 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: Autofire (SMG 3), Suppressive Fire

Concealable: No

Slots: 3 • Attachments: Foregrip • Mods: None

Special Features: Has 1 extra Attachment Slot (4 Total). While wielded in two hands, this weapon is considered Excellent Quality [Foregrip].

Range: SMG
Pre-installed: Foregrip (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (SMG 3), Suppressive Fire

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
